        ttk.Label(status, textvariable=self.mfa_var).pack(side="right", padx=8)

        # Notebook
        nb = ttk.Notebook(self.root)
        nb.pack(expand=True, fill="both")

        # Logs tab
        self.log_text = tk.Text(nb, height=15)
        self.log_text.configure(state="disabled")
        nb.add(self.log_text, text="Logs")

        # Agents tab
        agents_frame = ttk.Frame(nb, padding=8)
        nb.add(agents_frame, text="Agents")
        ttk.Label(agents_frame, text="Say something to NayDoeV1 (prefix 'jess:' to route to jessicAi)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.voice_entry = ttk.Entry(agents_frame)
        self.voice_entry.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        send_btn = ttk.Button(agents_frame, text="Send", command=self._send_agent_text)
        send_btn.pack(anchor="w")
        self.agent_out = tk.Text(agents_frame, height=10)
        self.agent_out.configure(state="disabled")
        self.agent_out.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=8)

        # Security tab
        sec = ttk.Frame(nb, padding=8)
        nb.add(sec, text="Security")
        self.alerts_box = tk.Listbox(sec, height=8)
        self.alerts_box.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        mfa_controls = ttk.Frame(sec)
        mfa_controls.pack(fill="x", pady=6)
        ttk.Label(mfa_controls, text="MFA token").pack(side="left")
        self.mfa_token = ttk.Entry(mfa_controls, width=40); self.mfa_token.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Label(mfa_controls, text="Channel").pack(side="left")
        self.mfa_channel = ttk.Combobox(mfa_controls, values=["email", "voicemail", "phonecall"], width=12)
        self.mfa_channel.set("email"); self.mfa_channel.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Label(mfa_controls, text="User").pack(side="left")
        self.mfa_user = ttk.Entry(mfa_controls, width=24); self.mfa_user.insert(0, "user@example.com"); self.mfa_user.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(mfa_controls, text="Start", command=self._mfa_start).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Label(mfa_controls, text="Code").pack(side="left")
        self.mfa_code = ttk.Entry(mfa_controls, width=10); self.mfa_code.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(mfa_controls, text="Verify", command=self._mfa_verify).pack(side="left", padx=4)

        # Updates tab
        upd = ttk.Frame(nb, padding=8)
        nb.add(upd, text="Updates")
        ttk.Button(upd, text="Check Updates", command=self._check_updates).pack(anchor="w")
        ttk.Button(upd, text="Apply Updates", command=self._apply_updates).pack(anchor="w", pady=4)
        self.upd_label = ttk.Label(upd, text=""); self.upd_label.pack(anchor="w", pady=6)

    def _append_log(self, text: str):
        self.log_text.configure(state="normal")
        self.log_text.insert("end", text + "\n")
        self.log_text.configure(state="disabled")
        self.log_text.see("end")

    def _append_agent_out(self, text: str):
        self.agent_out.configure(state="normal")
        self.agent_out.insert("end", text + "\n")
        self.agent_out.configure(state="disabled")
        self.agent_out.see("end")

    def _poll_tick(self):
        try:
            while True:
                item = self.app.ui_queue.get_nowait()
                kind, payload = item
                if kind == "log":
                    self._append_log(payload)
                elif kind == "status":
                    self.path_var.set(f"path: {payload.get('active')}")
                    self.wifi_var.set(f"Wi-Fi: {'up' if payload.get('wifi') else 'down'}")
                    self.ble_var.set(f"BLE: {'up' if payload.get('ble') else 'down'}")
                    self.cell_var.set(f"Cellular: {'up' if payload.get('cell') else 'down'}")
                    self.mfa_var.set(f"MFA tokens: {payload.get('mfa', 0)}")
                elif kind == "alert":
                    self.alerts_box.insert("end", payload)
                elif kind == "agent":
                    self._append_agent_out(payload)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.root.after(250, self._poll_tick)

    def _send_agent_text(self):
        text = self.voice_entry.get().strip()
        if not text:
            return
        self.app.submit_agent_text(text)
        self.voice_entry.delete(0, "end")

    def _mfa_start(self):
        token = self.mfa_token.get().strip()
        ch = self.mfa_channel.get().strip()
        user = self.mfa_user.get().strip()
        msg = self.app.start_mfa(token, ch, user)
        self._append_log(msg)

    def _mfa_verify(self):
        token = self.mfa_token.get().strip()
        ch = self.mfa_channel.get().strip()
        user = self.mfa_user.get().strip()
        code = self.mfa_code.get().strip()
        res = self.app.verify_mfa(token, ch, user, code)
        self._append_log(json.dumps(res))

    def _check_updates(self):
        self._append_log(self.app.update_mgr.check())

    def _apply_updates(self):
        self._append_log(self.app.update_mgr.apply())

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

# --------------------------- App Context & glue -------------------------------

class AppContext:
    """
    Bridges asyncio node/agents with Tk thread.
    """
    def __init__(self, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, node: ClusterNode):
        self.cluster_id = cluster_id
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.node = node
        self.voice = VoiceController()
        self.security = PortManAI()
        self.update_mgr = UpdateManager()
        self.ui_queue: "queue.Queue[Tuple[str, Any]]" = queue.Queue()
        # Agents and dispatcher
        self.jess = JessicaAiAgent()
        self.dispatcher = CommandDispatcher(
            cluster_id, node_id, node, self.security,
            agents={"jessicAi": self.jess},  # NayDoeV1 routes; not callable directly here
            auths=[EmailAuth(), VoicemailAuth(), PhoneCallAuth()],
        )
        self.nay = NayDoeV1Agent(self.dispatcher)
        # background thread for periodic status updates
        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
        self._status_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._status_worker, daemon=True)

    def start(self):
        self._status_thread.start()

    def stop(self):
        self._stop_event.set()

    def _status_worker(self):
        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
            active = self.node.active_path()
            status = {
                "active": active,
                "wifi": self.node.wifi.healthy(),
                "ble": self.node.ble.healthy(),
                "cell": self.node.relay.healthy(),
                "mfa": len(self.dispatcher.pending_mfa()),
            }
            self.ui_queue.put(("status", status))
            # surface new alerts
            while self.security.alerts:
                self.ui_queue.put(("alert", self.security.alerts.pop(0)))
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def submit_agent_text(self, text: str):
        # Security visibility
        self.ui_queue.put(("log", f"> {text}"))
        # Route through NayDoeV1
        async def _run():
            ctx = {"user": "user@example.com"}
            res = await self.nay.handle_text(text, ctx)
            self.ui_queue.put(("agent", json.dumps(res)))
        asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_run(), asyncio.get_event_loop())

    def start_mfa(self, token: str, channel: str, user: str) -> str:
        msg = self.dispatcher.start_mfa(token, channel, user)
        return msg

    def verify_mfa(self, token: str, channel: str, user: str, code: str) -> JSON:
        return self.dispatcher.verify_mfa(token, channel, user, code)

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="GUI dashboard + clustered networking + agents + security.")
    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=["relay-server", "node", "dashboard"], required=True)
    p.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0", help="Relay listen host (relay-server)")
    p.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=4040, help="Relay listen port (relay-server)")
    p.add_argument("--cluster", default="default", help="Cluster/room id (node/dashboard)")
    p.add_argument("--node", dest="node_id", default=os.getenv("HOSTNAME", "node"), help="Node id (node/dashboard)")
    p.add_argument("--lan-port", type=int, default=5000, help="Node TCP listen port (Wi-Fi)")
    p.add_argument("--mcast-group", default="239.255.0.1", help="Multicast group")
    p.add_argument("--mcast-port", type=int, default=9999, help="Multicast port")
    p.add_argument("--relay-host", default="127.0.0.1", help="Relay host (node/dashboard)")
    p.add_argument("--relay-port", type=int, default=4040, help="Relay port (node/dashboard)")
    p.add_argument("--enable-ble", action="store_true", help="Enable BLE stub transport")
    return p

async def run_relay(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    server = RelayServer(args.host, args.port)
    await server.start()
    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    for s in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            asyncio.get_running_loop().add_signal_handler(s, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    print("[relay] shutting down...")
    await server.stop()

async def run_node(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    wifi = WiFiTransport(args.cluster, args.node_id, args.lan_port, args.mcast_group, args.mcast_port)
    ble = BluetoothTransport(args.enable_ble, args.cluster, args.node_id)
    relay = RelayClientTransport(args.cluster, args.node_id, args.relay_host, args.relay_port)
    node = ClusterNode(args.cluster, args.node_id, wifi, ble, relay)

    print(f"[node] starting '{args.node_id}' in cluster '{args.cluster}'")
    print(f"  - {wifi.description()}\n  - {ble.description()}\n  - {relay.description()}")
    await node.start()
    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    for s in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            asyncio.get_running_loop().add_signal_handler(s, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    print("[node] shutting down...")
    await node.stop()

def _start_gui_thread(app: AppContext):
    if tk is None:
        print("Tkinter not available.", file=sys.stderr)
        return
    gui = DashboardGUI(app)
    gui.run()

async def run_dashboard(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    # Node under the hood so UI has a live transport + cluster connectivity
    wifi = WiFiTransport(args.cluster, args.node_id, args.lan_port, args.mcast_group, args.mcast_port)
    ble = BluetoothTransport(True, args.cluster, args.node_id)
    relay = RelayClientTransport(args.cluster, args.node_id, args.relay_host, args.relay_port)
    node = ClusterNode(args.cluster, args.node_id, wifi, ble, relay)
    await node.start()

    app = AppContext(args.cluster, args.node_id, node)
    app.start()

    # GUI in another thread; asyncio loop keeps networking alive
    t = threading.Thread(target=_start_gui_thread, args=(app,), daemon=True)
    t.start()

    # Pump cluster chatter from relay back to logs (basic)
    async def printer():
        while True:
            # we reuse the node's internal inbox by tapping the relay queue
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            # status already polled by app thread

    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    for s in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            asyncio.get_running_loop().add_signal_handler(s, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    app.stop()
    await node.stop()

def main() -> None:
    args = build_parser().parse_args()
    if args.mode == "relay-server":
        asyncio.run(run_relay(args))
    elif args.mode == "node":
        asyncio.run(run_node(args))
    else:
        asyncio.run(run_dashboard(args))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    iproute2 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || true

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# file: cluster_suite_v2.py
"""
cluster_suite_v2.py
Complex multi-instance cluster + relay + debug telemetry for macOS/Linux/Windows (Python 3.10+).
Modes: relay-server, node, sim (N virtual nodes).

Usage examples:
  # Relay
  python cluster_suite_v2.py --mode relay-server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4040 --debug-port 8080

  # Single node (connects to relay)
  python cluster_suite_v2.py --mode node --cluster myfleet --node nodeA \
      --lan-port 5001 --relay-host localhost --relay-port 4040 --debug-port 8081 --verbose

  # Simulation of 8 nodes (in-process)
  python cluster_suite_v2.py --mode sim --sim-count 8 --debug-port 8080 --sim-churn 1.5

Notes:
 - This is a developer/test harness. Replace BLE/voice/auth with real providers later.
 - Telemetry endpoint: /metrics and /nodes on debug-port (HTTP JSON).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import contextlib
import dataclasses
import json
import logging
import os
import random
import signal
import socket
import struct
import sys
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple

# ----------------------------- Utilities -------------------------------------

VERSION = "2.0"

def now_s() -> float:
    return time.time()

def jitter(base: float, factor: float = 0.25) -> float:
    return base * (1.0 + random.uniform(-factor, factor))

def json_dumps(obj: Any) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":"), default=str) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def local_ip() -> str:
    with contextlib.closing(socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)) as s:
        try:
            s.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))
            return s.getsockname()[0]
        except Exception:
            return "127.0.0.1"

# --------------------------- Logging helpers ---------------------------------

def make_logger(name: str, level=logging.INFO, prefix: Optional[str]=None) -> logging.Logger:
    logger = logging.getLogger(name)
    if not logger.handlers:
        handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
        fmt = "%(asctime)s %(levelname)s [%(name)s] %(message)s"
        handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter(fmt))
        logger.addHandler(handler)
    logger.setLevel(level)
    return logger

ROOT_LOG = make_logger("cluster", level=logging.INFO)

# --------------------------- Message schema ----------------------------------

@dataclass
class Message:
    type: str
    cluster_id: str
    node_id: str
    ts: float
    payload: Dict[str, Any]

    def to_json(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return dataclasses.asdict(self)

    @staticmethod
    def from_json(obj: Dict[str, Any]) -> "Message":
        return Message(
            type=str(obj["type"]),
            cluster_id=str(obj["cluster_id"]),
            node_id=str(obj["node_id"]),
            ts=float(obj.get("ts", now_s())),
            payload=dict(obj.get("payload", {})),
        )

def make_msg(msg_type: str, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Message:
    return Message(type=msg_type, cluster_id=cluster_id, node_id=node_id, ts=now_s(), payload=payload)

# --------------------------- Transport interface ------------------------------

class Transport:
    name: str
    async def start(self) -> None: ...
    async def stop(self) -> None: ...
    async def send(self, msg: Message) -> None: ...
    def healthy(self) -> bool: ...
    def description(self) -> str: ...

# --------------------------- Wi-Fi Transport ---------------------------------

class WiFiTransport(Transport):
    def __init__(self, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, listen_port: int = 5000,
                 mcast_group: str = "239.255.0.1", mcast_port: int = 9999,
                 gossip_interval: float = 1.5, logger: Optional[logging.Logger]=None):
        self.name = "wifi"
        self.cluster_id = cluster_id
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.listen_port = listen_port
        self.mgroup = mcast_group
        self.mport = mcast_port
        self.gossip_interval = gossip_interval
        self.logger = logger or make_logger(f"wifi:{node_id}", level=logging.INFO)
        self._server: Optional[asyncio.AbstractServer] = None
        self._peers: Dict[str, Tuple[asyncio.StreamReader, asyncio.StreamWriter, float]] = {}
        self._peers_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        self._running = False
        self._healthy = False
        self.telemetry = {"sent":0, "recv":0, "connects":0, "drops":0}
        self._seen_mcast: Set[Tuple[str,int]] = set()

    def description(self) -> str:
        return f"WiFi {local_ip()}:{self.listen_port} mcast={self.mgroup}:{self.mport}"

    def healthy(self) -> bool:
        return self._healthy

    async def start(self) -> None:
        self._running = True
        self._server = await asyncio.start_server(self._handle_peer, host="0.0.0.0", port=self.listen_port)
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._multicast_sender()))
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._multicast_listener()))
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._peer_maintenance()))
        self._healthy = True
        self.logger.debug("WiFiTransport started")

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._running = False
        if self._server:
            self._server.close()
            await self._server.wait_closed()
        for t in self._tasks:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self._tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        async with self._peers_lock:
            for _, (_, w, _) in list(self._peers.items()):
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    w.close()
                    await w.wait_closed()
            self._peers.clear()
        self._healthy = False
        self.logger.debug("WiFiTransport stopped")

    async def send(self, msg: Message) -> None:
        data = json_dumps(msg.to_json())
        async with self._peers_lock:
            dead = []
            for pid, (r, w, _) in self._peers.items():
                try:
                    w.write(data)
                    await w.drain()
                    self.telemetry["sent"] += 1
                except Exception:
                    dead.append(pid)
            for pid in dead:
                self.telemetry["drops"] += 1
                r, w, _ = self._peers.pop(pid, (None, None, 0.0))
                if w:
                    with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                        w.close()
                        await w.wait_closed()

    async def _handle_peer(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
        peer_id = None
        try:
            hello = await _read_json_line(reader)
            if not hello or hello.get("type") != "hello" or hello.get("cluster_id") != self.cluster_id:
                writer.close()
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    await writer.wait_closed()
                return
            peer_id = hello.get("node_id", f"peer-{random.randint(1000,9999)}")
            async with self._peers_lock:
                self._peers[peer_id] = (reader, writer, now_s())
                self.telemetry["connects"] += 1
            writer.write(json_dumps({"type":"ack","cluster_id":self.cluster_id,"node_id":self.node_id,"ts":now_s()}))
            await writer.drain()
            while True:
                obj = await _read_json_line(reader)
                if obj is None:
                    break
                self.telemetry["recv"] += 1
                # nothing further here; ClusterNode will inspect peer-level messages
                async with self._peers_lock:
                    if peer_id in self._peers:
                        r, w, _ = self._peers[peer_id]
                        self._peers[peer_id] = (r, w, now_s())
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.debug("peer handler error: %s", e)
        finally:
            async with self._peers_lock:
                if peer_id and peer_id in self._peers:
                    self._peers.pop(peer_id, None)
                    self.telemetry["drops"] += 1
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                writer.close()
                await writer.wait_closed()

    async def _connect_to_peer(self, host: str, port: int, peer_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(host=host, port=port)
            hello = {"type":"hello","cluster_id":self.cluster_id,"node_id":self.node_id,"ts":now_s()}
            writer.write(json_dumps(hello)); await writer.drain()
            async with self._peers_lock:
                self._peers[peer_id] = (reader, writer, now_s()); self.telemetry["connects"] += 1
            while True:
                obj = await _read_json_line(reader)
                if obj is None:
                    break
                self.telemetry["recv"] += 1
                async with self._peers_lock:
                    if peer_id in self._peers:
                        r, w, _ = self._peers[peer_id]
                        self._peers[peer_id] = (r, w, now_s())
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.debug("connect_to_peer failed %s:%s -> %s", host, port, e)
        finally:
            async with self._peers_lock:
                if peer_id in self._peers:
                    self._peers.pop(peer_id, None)
                    self.telemetry["drops"] += 1

    async def _peer_maintenance(self) -> None:
        while self._running:
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            cutoff = now_s() - 30.0
            async with self._peers_lock:
                dead = [pid for pid, (_,_,ts) in self._peers.items() if ts < cutoff]
                for pid in dead:
                    r, w, _ = self._peers.pop(pid, (None, None, 0.0))
                    if w:
                        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                            w.close()
                            await w.wait_closed()
                        self.telemetry["drops"] += 1

    async def _multicast_sender(self) -> None:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM, socket.IPPROTO_UDP)
        ttl = struct.pack('b', 1)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IP, socket.IP_MULTICAST_TTL, ttl)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IP, socket.IP_MULTICAST_LOOP, 1)
        sock.setblocking(False)
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        try:
            while self._running:
                packet = {"type":"mcast_hello","cluster_id":self.cluster_id,"node_id":self.node_id,"ts":now_s(),"port":self.listen_port,"ip":local_ip()}
                try:
                    await loop.sock_sendto(sock, json_dumps(packet), (self.mgroup, self.mport))
                except Exception as e:
                    self.logger.debug("mcast send failed: %s", e)
                await asyncio.sleep(jitter(self.gossip_interval))
        finally:
            sock.close()

    async def _multicast_listener(self) -> None:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM, socket.IPPROTO_UDP)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        try:
            sock.bind(("", self.mport))
        except OSError:
            sock.bind((self.mgroup, self.mport))
        mreq = struct.pack("=4sl", socket.inet_aton(self.mgroup), socket.INADDR_ANY)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IP, socket.IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP, mreq)
        sock.setblocking(False)
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        try:
            while self._running:
                try:
                    data, addr = await asyncio.wait_for(loop.sock_recvfrom(sock, 65535), timeout=1.0)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    obj = json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
                    if obj.get("type") == "mcast_hello" and obj.get("cluster_id") == self.cluster_id:
                        peer_id = obj.get("node_id")
                        if peer_id == self.node_id:
                            continue
                        host = obj.get("ip") or addr[0]
                        port = int(obj.get("port", self.listen_port))
                        key = (host, port)
                        if key not in self._seen_mcast:
                            self._seen_mcast.add(key)
                            asyncio.create_task(self._connect_to_peer(host, port, peer_id))
        finally:
            sock.close()

    # For debug/inspection
    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {"name": self.name, "node_id": self.node_id, "peers": list(self._peers.keys()), "telemetry": dict(self.telemetry)}

# --------------------------- Relay server & client ---------------------------

class RelayServer:
    def __init__(self, host: str, port: int, logger: Optional[logging.Logger]=None):
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.logger = logger or make_logger("relay", level=logging.INFO)
        self._server: Optional[asyncio.AbstractServer] = None
        self._rooms: Dict[str, Set[asyncio.StreamWriter]] = {}
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.telemetry = {"rooms":0, "joins":0, "msgs":0, "clients":0}

    async def start(self) -> None:
        self._server = await asyncio.start_server(self._handle, host=self.host, port=self.port)
        addr = ", ".join(str(sock.getsockname()) for sock in self._server.sockets) if self._server.sockets else f"{self.host}:{self.port}"
        self.logger.info("Relay listening on %s", addr)

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._server:
            self._server.close()
            await self._server.wait_closed()
        async with self._lock:
            for writers in self._rooms.values():
                for w in list(writers):
                    with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                        w.close()
                        await w.wait_closed()
            self._rooms.clear()

    async def _handle(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
        room: Optional[str] = None
        try:
            hello = await _read_json_line(reader)
            if not hello or hello.get("type") != "relay_join":
                writer.close(); await writer.wait_closed(); return
            room = str(hello.get("cluster_id", "default"))
            node_id = str(hello.get("node_id", "unknown"))
            async with self._lock:
                self._rooms.setdefault(room, set()).add(writer); self.telemetry["joins"] += 1; self.telemetry["clients"] = sum(len(v) for v in self._rooms.values())
            self.logger.debug("join %s -> %s", node_id, room)
            while True:
                obj = await _read_json_line(reader)
                if obj is None:
                    break
                self.telemetry["msgs"] += 1
                await self._broadcast(room, writer, obj)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.debug("relay handle error: %s", e)
        finally:
            if room is not None:
                async with self._lock:
                    writers = self._rooms.get(room, set())
                    if writer in writers:
                        writers.remove(writer)
                        self.telemetry["clients"] = sum(len(v) for v in self._rooms.values())
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                writer.close(); await writer.wait_closed()

    async def _broadcast(self, room: str, sender: asyncio.StreamWriter, obj: Dict[str,Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            writers = list(self._rooms.get(room, set()))
        data = json_dumps(obj)
        for w in writers:
            if w is sender: continue
            try:
                w.write(data); await w.drain()
            except Exception:
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                    w.close(); await w.wait_closed()
                async with self._lock:
                    self._rooms.get(room, set()).discard(w)

    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {"host": self.host, "port": self.port, "rooms": {r: len(w) for r,w in self._rooms.items()}, "telemetry": dict(self.telemetry)}

class RelayClient(Transport):
    def __init__(self, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, host: str, port: int, logger: Optional[logging.Logger]=None):
        self.name = "relay"
        self.cluster_id = cluster_id
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.logger = logger or make_logger(f"relayc:{node_id}", level=logging.INFO)
        self._reader: Optional[asyncio.StreamReader] = None
        self._writer: Optional[asyncio.StreamWriter] = None
        self._tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        self._running = False
        self._healthy = False
        self.incoming: asyncio.Queue[Dict[str,Any]] = asyncio.Queue()
        self.telemetry = {"sent":0,"recv":0,"reconnects":0}

    def description(self) -> str:
        return f"Relay -> {self.host}:{self.port}"

    def healthy(self) -> bool:
        return self._healthy

    async def start(self) -> None:
        self._running = True
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._run()))

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._running = False
        for t in self._tasks:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self._tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        await self._close()

    async def _close(self) -> None:
        if self._writer:
            with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                self._writer.close(); await self._writer.wait_closed()
        self._reader = None; self._writer = None; self._healthy = False

    async def _run(self) -> None:
        backoff = 1.0
        while self._running:
            try:
                self._reader, self._writer = await asyncio.open_connection(self.host, self.port)
                hello = {"type":"relay_join","cluster_id":self.cluster_id,"node_id":self.node_id,"ts":now_s()}
                self._writer.write(json_dumps(hello)); await self._writer.drain()
                self._healthy = True; self.telemetry["reconnects"] = 0
                while self._running:
                    obj = await _read_json_line(self._reader)
                    if obj is None:
                        raise ConnectionError("relay EOF")
                    self.telemetry["recv"] += 1
                    await self.incoming.put(obj)
            except Exception as e:
                self._healthy = False
                self.telemetry["reconnects"] += 1
                await self._close()
                await asyncio.sleep(jitter(min(backoff, 10.0)))
                backoff = min(backoff*2, 10.0)

    async def send(self, msg: Message) -> None:
        if not self._writer:
            return
        try:
            self._writer.write(json_dumps(msg.to_json())); await self._writer.drain(); self.telemetry["sent"] += 1
        except Exception:
            await self._close()

    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str,Any]:
        return {"name":self.name,"node_id":self.node_id,"host":self.host,"port":self.port,"healthy":self._healthy,"telemetry":dict(self.telemetry)}

class BluetoothTransport(Transport):
    def __init__(self, enabled: bool, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, logger: Optional[logging.Logger]=None):
        self.name = "ble"
        self.enabled = enabled
        self.cluster_id = cluster_id
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.logger = logger or make_logger(f"ble:{node_id}", level=logging.DEBUG)
        self._healthy = False
        self.telemetry = {"sent":0,"recv":0}

    def description(self) -> str:
        return f"BLE (stub, {'on' if self.enabled else 'off'})"

    def healthy(self) -> bool:
        return self._healthy

    async def start(self) -> None:
        if self.enabled:
            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
            self._healthy = True
            self.logger.debug("BLE enabled")

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._healthy = False

    async def send(self, msg: Message) -> None:
        if self.enabled:
            self.telemetry["sent"] += 1

    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str,Any]:
        return {"name":self.name,"enabled":self.enabled,"healthy":self._healthy,"telemetry":dict(self.telemetry)}

# --------------------------- Cluster node ------------------------------------

class ClusterNode:
    def __init__(self, cluster_id: str, node_id: str, wifi: WiFiTransport, ble: BluetoothTransport, relay: RelayClient, priority: Tuple[str,...]=("wifi","ble","relay"), logger: Optional[logging.Logger]=None):
        self.cluster_id = cluster_id
        self.node_id = node_id
        self.wifi = wifi
        self.ble = ble
        self.relay = relay
        self.priority = priority
        self.logger = logger or make_logger(f"node:{node_id}", level=logging.INFO)
        self._running = False
        self._active: Optional[str] = None
        self.app_inbox: asyncio.Queue[Message] = asyncio.Queue()
        self._tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        self.telemetry = {"sent":0,"recv":0,"gossip":0,"last_active_change":now_s()}
        self.relay.incoming  # ensure exists

    def active_path(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self._active

    async def start(self) -> None:
        self._running = True
        await asyncio.gather(self.wifi.start(), self.ble.start(), self.relay.start())
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._chooser()))
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._gossip()))
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._drain_relay()))
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._process_app_inbox()))
        self.logger.info("node started: %s", self.node_id)

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._running = False
        for t in self._tasks:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self._tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        await asyncio.gather(self.wifi.stop(), self.ble.stop(), self.relay.stop())
        self.logger.info("node stopped: %s", self.node_id)

    async def _chooser(self) -> None:
        last = None
        while self._running:
            healthy = {"wifi": self.wifi.healthy(), "ble": self.ble.healthy(), "relay": self.relay.healthy()}
            chosen = None
            for p in self.priority:
                if healthy.get(p):
                    chosen = p; break
            self._active = chosen
            if chosen != last:
                self.telemetry["last_active_change"] = now_s()
                self.logger.info("active path -> %s (health=%s)", chosen, healthy)
                last = chosen
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    async def _gossip(self) -> None:
        while self._running:
            msg = make_msg("gossip", self.cluster_id, self.node_id, {"ip": local_ip(), "active": self._active})
            await self.send(msg)
            self.telemetry["gossip"] += 1
            await asyncio.sleep(2.0 + random.random()*1.0)

    async def send(self, msg: Message) -> None:
        path = self._active
        if path == "wifi":
            await self.wifi.send(msg)
        elif path == "ble":
            await self.ble.send(msg)
        elif path == "relay":
            await self.relay.send(msg)
        else:
            # nothing: keep in local telemetry
            self.logger.debug("no path to send message %s", msg.type)
            return
        self.telemetry["sent"] += 1

    async def _drain_relay(self) -> None:
        while self._running:
            obj = await self.relay.incoming.get()
            try:
                msg = Message.from_json(obj)
                if msg.cluster_id != self.cluster_id:
                    continue
                self.telemetry["recv"] += 1
                await self.app_inbox.put(msg)
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.debug("relay drain parse error %s", e)

    async def _process_app_inbox(self) -> None:
        while self._running:
            msg: Message = await self.app_inbox.get()
            # simple handlers
            if msg.type == "gossip":
                # update membership table (omitted for brevity)
                self.logger.debug("gossip from %s", msg.node_id)
            elif msg.type == "chat":
                self.logger.info("chat %s -> %s", msg.node_id, msg.payload.get("text"))
            else:
                self.logger.debug("recv %s from %s", msg.type, msg.node_id)

    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str,Any]:
        return {
            "node_id": self.node_id,
            "cluster": self.cluster_id,
            "active": self._active,
            "telemetry": dict(self.telemetry),
            "wifi": self.wifi.snapshot(),
            "ble": self.ble.snapshot(),
            "relay": self.relay.snapshot(),
        }

# --------------------------- Helpers -----------------------------------------

async def _read_json_line(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, timeout: Optional[float]=None) -> Optional[Dict[str,Any]]:
    try:
        if timeout:
            line = await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(), timeout=timeout)
        else:
            line = await reader.readline()
        if not line:
            return None
        return json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None

# --------------------------- Debug HTTP server -------------------------------

from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
class DebugHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "ClusterDebug/1.0"
    def _ok(self, obj):
        data = json.dumps(obj, default=str).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json"); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data))); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        srv: DebugHTTPServer = self.server  # type: ignore
        path = self.path.split("?",1)[0]
        if path == "/metrics":
            self._ok(srv.collect_metrics())
        elif path == "/nodes":
            self._ok(srv.collect_nodes())
        elif path.startswith("/trace"):
            q = {}
            if "?" in self.path:
                try:
                    _, qs = self.path.split("?",1)
                    for part in qs.split("&"):
                        k,v = part.split("=",1)
                        q[k]=v
                except Exception:
                    pass
            node = q.get("node")
            self._ok(srv.collect_trace(node))
        else:
            self.send_response(404); self.end_headers()

class DebugHTTPServer(HTTPServer):
    def __init__(self, addr, collector, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(addr, RequestHandlerClass=DebugHandler, *args, **kwargs)
        self._collector = collector

    def collect_metrics(self):
        return self._collector.metrics()

    def collect_nodes(self):
        return self._collector.nodes()

    def collect_trace(self, node_id: Optional[str]):
        return self._collector.trace(node_id)

class DebugCollector:
    def __init__(self):
        self._nodes_snap: Dict[str, Dict[str,Any]] = {}
        self._relay_snap: Dict[str,Any] = {}
        self._trace_log: Dict[str, List[Dict[str,Any]]] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def update_node(self, node_id: str, snap: Dict[str,Any]):
        with self._lock:
            self._nodes_snap[node_id] = snap
            self._trace_log.setdefault(node_id, []).append({"ts": now_s(), "snap": snap})
            if len(self._trace_log[node_id]) > 50:
                self._trace_log[node_id].pop(0)

    def update_relay(self, snap: Dict[str,Any]):
        with self._lock:
            self._relay_snap = snap

    def metrics(self):
        with self._lock:
            total_nodes = len(self._nodes_snap)
            summary = {"total_nodes": total_nodes, "nodes": {k: v["telemetry"] for k,v in self._nodes_snap.items()}, "relay": self._relay_snap.get("telemetry")}
            return summary

    def nodes(self):
        with self._lock:
            return dict(self._nodes_snap)

    def trace(self, node_id: Optional[str]):
        with self._lock:
            if node_id:
                return self._trace_log.get(node_id, [])
            return self._trace_log

# --------------------------- Simulator ---------------------------------------

class Simulator:
    def __init__(self, cluster: str, count: int, relay_host: str, relay_port: int, debug_collector: DebugCollector, churn: Optional[float]=None):
        self.cluster = cluster
        self.count = count
        self.relay_host = relay_host
        self.relay_port = relay_port
        self.debug_collector = debug_collector
        self.churn = churn
        self.nodes: List[ClusterNode] = []
        self._tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        self.logger = make_logger("sim", level=logging.INFO)

    async def start(self):
        # create relay client endpoints that connect to local relay or to in-process relay if not provided
        for i in range(self.count):
            nid = f"sim-{int(time.time())%10000}-{i}"
            wifi = WiFiTransport(self.cluster, nid, listen_port=6000 + i, logger=make_logger(f"wifi:{nid}", level=logging.WARNING))
            ble = BluetoothTransport(enabled=False, cluster_id=self.cluster, node_id=nid, logger=make_logger(f"ble:{nid}", level=logging.DEBUG))
            relayc = RelayClient(self.cluster, nid, host=self.relay_host, port=self.relay_port, logger=make_logger(f"relayc:{nid}", level=logging.WARNING))
            node = ClusterNode(self.cluster, nid, wifi, ble, relayc, logger=make_logger(f"node:{nid}", level=logging.INFO))
            self.nodes.append(node)
            await node.start()
            # start periodic snapshot push to debug collector
            t = asyncio.create_task(self._snapshot_worker(node))
            self._tasks.append(t)
            # optional jittered start delay
            await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
        # optional churn
        if self.churn and self.churn > 0:
            self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._churn_worker()))

    async def stop(self):
        for t in self._tasks:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self._tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        for node in self.nodes:
            await node.stop()

    async def _snapshot_worker(self, node: ClusterNode):
        while True:
            snap = node.snapshot()
            self.debug_collector.update_node(node.node_id, snap)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.7)

    async def _churn_worker(self):
        # randomly toggle WiFi health to force relay failover
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.churn)
            victim = random.choice(self.nodes)
            # toggle wifi healthy by stopping/starting wifi transport
            if victim.wifi._running:
                ROOT_LOG.info("SIM: toggling off wifi for %s", victim.node_id)
                await victim.wifi.stop()
            else:
                ROOT_LOG.info("SIM: toggling on wifi for %s", victim.node_id)
                await victim.wifi.start()

# --------------------------- CLI + Runners -----------------------------------

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Cluster Suite v2 — multi-instance + debug")
    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=["relay-server","node","sim"], required=True)
    p.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0", help="Relay host (relay-server)")
    p.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=4040, help="Relay port (relay-server)")
    p.add_argument("--cluster", default="default", help="Cluster id")
    p.add_argument("--node", dest="node_id", default=os.getenv("HOSTNAME","node"), help="Node id")
    p.add_argument("--lan-port", type=int, default=5000, help="Node LAN TCP listen port")
    p.add_argument("--mcast-group", default="239.255.0.1", help="Multicast group")
    p.add_argument("--mcast-port", type=int, default=9999, help="Multicast port")
    p.add_argument("--relay-host", default="127.0.0.1", help="Relay host (node/sim)")
    p.add_argument("--relay-port", type=int, default=4040, help="Relay port (node/sim)")
    p.add_argument("--enable-ble", action="store_true", help="Enable BLE stub")
    p.add_argument("--sim-count", type=int, default=5, help="Number of simulated nodes (sim mode)")
    p.add_argument("--sim-churn", type=float, default=0.0, help="Seconds between churn events (0 disables)")
    p.add_argument("--debug-port", type=int, default=0, help="Start debug HTTP server on this port (0 disables)")
    p.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help="Verbose logging")
    return p

def start_debug_http(port: int, collector: DebugCollector):
    if port <= 0:
        return None
    def _run():
        server = DebugHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), collector)
        ROOT_LOG.info("Debug HTTP server listening on http://0.0.0.0:%d (endpoints /metrics /nodes /trace)", port)
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass
        finally:
            server.server_close()
    t = threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    return t

async def run_relay(args, collector: Optional[DebugCollector]=None):
    logger = make_logger("relay-main", level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO)
    relay = RelayServer(args.host, args.port, logger=logger)
    await relay.start()
    if collector:
        collector.update_relay(relay.snapshot())
    # install shutdown hooks
    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for s in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            loop.add_signal_handler(s, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    await relay.stop()

async def run_node(args, collector: Optional[DebugCollector]=None):
    logger = make_logger(f"node-main:{args.node_id}", level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO)
    wifi = WiFiTransport(args.cluster, args.node_id, listen_port=args.lan_port, mcast_group=args.mcast_group, mcast_port=args.mcast_port, logger=make_logger(f"wifi:{args.node_id}", level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO))
    ble = BluetoothTransport(enabled=args.enable_ble, cluster_id=args.cluster, node_id=args.node_id, logger=make_logger(f"ble:{args.node_id}", level=logging.DEBUG))
    relay = RelayClient(args.cluster, args.node_id, host=args.relay_host, port=args.relay_port, logger=make_logger(f"relayc:{args.node_id}", level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO))
    node = ClusterNode(args.cluster, args.node_id, wifi, ble, relay, logger=logger)
    await node.start()
    if collector:
        # push snapshots periodically
        async def snap():
            while True:
                collector.update_node(node.node_id, node.snapshot())
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
        s = asyncio.create_task(snap())
    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for sgn in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            loop.add_signal_handler(sgn, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    await node.stop()

async def run_sim(args, collector: Optional[DebugCollector]=None):
    sim = Simulator(args.cluster, args.sim_count, args.relay_host, args.relay_port, collector or DebugCollector(), churn=args.sim_churn)
    await sim.start()
    stop_event = asyncio.Event()
    def _stop(*_): stop_event.set()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for sgn in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            loop.add_signal_handler(sgn, _stop)
    await stop_event.wait()
    await sim.stop()

def main():
    args = build_parser().parse_args()
    if args.verbose:
        ROOT_LOG.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    collector = DebugCollector() if args.debug_port else None
    # start debug HTTP server (thread)
    if args.debug_port:
        start_debug_http(args.debug_port, collector)
    try:
        if args.mode == "relay-server":

def normalize_ascii(s: str) -> str:
    """ASCII fold (remove diacritics)."""
    s_norm = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", s or "")
    return s_norm.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")

# Superscript digit mapping: insert a hyphen BEFORE the digit (Alien³ -> Alien-3)
_SUPERSCRIPT_MAP = {
    "⁰": "-0", "¹": "-1", "²": "-2", "³": "-3", "⁴": "-4",
    "⁵": "-5", "⁶": "-6", "⁷": "-7", "⁸": "-8", "⁹": "-9",
}
_FRACTIONS_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[¼½¾⅐⅑⅒⅓⅔⅕⅖⅗⅘⅙⅚⅛⅜⅝⅞]")  # remove entirely
# Single letter in parentheses (e.g., (s), (E)) -> that letter
_PARENS_LETTER_RE = re.compile(r"\(\s*([A-Za-z])\s*\)")
# Remove comma between digits: 20,000 -> 20000
_COMMA_IN_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=\d),(?=\d)")
# Remove '*' only when between letters (F***ed -> Fed)
_STARS_BETWEEN_LETTERS_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=[a-zA-Z])\*+(?=[a-zA-Z])")
# Remove '@' when inside a word (between alphanumerics)
_AT_INSIDE_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=\w)@(?=\w)")
# '$' attached to a word becomes 's'
_DOLLAR_TO_S_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=\w)\$")
# Collapse remaining non-alphanumerics to '-'
_NON_ALNUM_RE = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9_]+")
# Remove hyphen only when between digits (30-10 -> 3010), handled after protection
_DIGIT_HYPHEN_DIGIT_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=\d)-(?=\d)")
# Protect 4-digit year pairs so we keep a hyphen later — allow spaces around sep
_YEAR_PAIR_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})\s*[\/:\.-]\s*(\d{4})")
# Protect abbreviated year ranges like 1968-75 — allow spaces around sep
_YEAR_PAIR_ABBR_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})\s*[\/:\.-]\s*(\d{2})(?!\d)")
# Collapse full dates like 2005.12.13 → 20051213
_DATE_TRIPLE_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})\s*[\.:\-\/]\s*(\d{2})\s*[\.:\-\/]\s*(\d{2})")

def _apply_superscripts(s: str) -> str:
    return "".join(_SUPERSCRIPT_MAP.get(ch, ch) for ch in (s or ""))

def _transliterate_pre_ascii(s: str, enable_polish: bool) -> str:
    """
    Pre-ASCII transliteration that runs BEFORE normalize_ascii().
    - Always map 'ø/Ø' -> 'o/O' (existing behavior).
    - If enable_polish=True: map Polish letters to ASCII equivalents.
    """
    if not s:
        return s
    # Always keep the older special map for ø/Ø
    s = s.replace("ø", "o").replace("Ø", "O")

    if enable_polish:
        # Polish transliteration
        table = {
            "ł": "l", "Ł": "L",
            "ś": "s", "Ś": "S",
            "ć": "c", "Ć": "C",
            "ó": "o", "Ó": "O",
            "ą": "a", "Ą": "A",
            "ę": "e", "Ę": "E",
            "ń": "n", "Ń": "N",
            "ź": "z", "Ź": "Z",
            "ż": "z", "Ż": "Z",
        }
        s = "".join(table.get(ch, ch) for ch in s)
    return s

def title_to_compare_slug_core(full_tmdb_title: str, *, enable_polish_map: bool, enable_year_whitespace_and_date: bool) -> str:
    r"""
    Build the comparison slug from TMDBTitle with our rules.
    - If enable_polish_map=True, apply Polish transliteration before ASCII fold.
    - If enable_year_whitespace_and_date=True, accept spaces around year separators
      and collapse full dates like 2005.12.13 -> 20051213.

      1) Superscripts → insert hyphen + digit           (Alien³ -> Alien-3)
      2) Remove Unicode fractions entirely              (33⅓ -> 33)
      3) Pre-ASCII transliteration:
         - Always: 'ø'/'Ø' → 'o'/'O'
         - Optional: Polish set (ł→l, ś→s, ć→c, ó→o, ą→a, ę→e, ń→n, ź→z, ż→z)
      4) ASCII fold                                     (diacritics removed)
      5) Delete '&'
      6) Any single letter in parentheses → that letter ((e) → e, (S) → s)
      7) (If enabled) Date/year handling (if enabled)
         - 2005.12.13 → 20051213   (collapse full date)
         - (\d{4})\s*[-:/.]\s*(\d{4}) → keep hyphen later
         - (\d{4})\s*[-:/.]\s*(\d{2}) → keep hyphen later  (e.g., 1968-75)
      8) Protect '/' and ':' globally (become hyphens later)
      9) Lowercase
     10) Remove apostrophes; remove periods
     11) Remove comma between digits (20,000 -> 20000)
     12) Remove '*' when BETWEEN letters (F***ed -> Fed)
     13) Remove '@' when INSIDE a word (D@bbe -> Dbbe)
     14) '$' attached to a word becomes 's' (Cake$ -> Cakes)
     15) Collapse remaining NON-alphanumerics to '-'
     16) Remove '-' only when directly between digits (30-10 -> 3010),
         BUT NOT for protected year pairs or for '/' or ':'
     17) Realize protected tokens as hyphens; collapse multiple '-'
     18) Trim '-'
    """
    if not full_tmdb_title:
        return ""

    # (1) superscripts
    s = _apply_superscripts(full_tmdb_title)
    # (2) fractions removed
    s = _FRACTIONS_PATTERN.sub("", s)

    # (3) pre-ASCII transliteration
    s = _transliterate_pre_ascii(s, enable_polish=enable_polish_map)

    # (4) ASCII fold
    s = normalize_ascii(s)

    # (5) delete '&'
    s = s.replace("&", "")

    # (6) (x) -> x
    s = _PARENS_LETTER_RE.sub(r"\1", s)

    # (7) year/date handling (if enabled)
    if enable_year_whitespace_and_date:
        # Collapse full dates to YYYYMMDD
        s = _DATE_TRIPLE_RE.sub(r"\1\2\3", s)
        # Protect year pairs (use tokens to survive later steps)
        s = _YEAR_PAIR_RE.sub(r"\1 __YEAR__ \2", s)
        s = _YEAR_PAIR_ABBR_RE.sub(r"\1 __YEAR2__ \2", s)
    else:
        # Old behavior (no whitespace allowed around separators)
        s = re.sub(r"(\d{4})[\/:\.-](\d{4})", r"\1 __YEAR__ \2", s)
        s = re.sub(r"(\d{4})[\/:\.-](\d{2})(?!\d)", r"\1 __YEAR2__ \2", s)

    # (8) protect slash and colon
    s = s.replace("/", " __SLASH__ ").replace(":", " __COLON__ ")

    # (9) lowercase
    s = s.lower()

    # (10) remove apostrophes and periods
    s = re.sub(r"[\'’]", "", s)
    s = s.replace(".", "")

    # (11) comma in numbers
    s = _COMMA_IN_NUMBER_RE.sub("", s)

    # (12) stars between letters
    s = _STARS_BETWEEN_LETTERS_RE.sub("", s)

    # (13) '@' inside word
    s = _AT_INSIDE_WORD_RE.sub("", s)

    # (14) dollar to 's'
    s = _DOLLAR_TO_S_RE.sub("s", s)

    # (15) collapse remaining non-alphanumerics to '-'
    s = _NON_ALNUM_RE.sub("-", s).strip("-")

    # Convert protected tokens to sentinels (not '-')
    s = (
        s.replace("__year__", "¥")
         .replace("__year2__", "¶")
         .replace("__slash__", "§")
         .replace("__colon__", "¤")
    )

    # (16) remove hyphen only directly between digits
    s = _DIGIT_HYPHEN_DIGIT_RE.sub("", s)

    # (17) realize sentinels as '-', collapse consecutive '-'
    s = s.replace("¥", "-").replace("¶", "-").replace("§", "-").replace("¤", "-")
    s = re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", s)

    # (18) trim
    return s.strip("-")

def title_to_compare_slug(full_tmdb_title: str) -> str:

def is_contiguous_subset(slug_tail: str, base_slug: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if the '-' chunks of slug_tail appear as a contiguous block
    within the '-' chunks of base_slug.
    Examples:
      slug='a-b' in base='x-a-b-y' -> True
      slug='a-b' in base='a-b'     -> True  (but this would be a match, not a mismatch)
      slug='a-b' in base='a-x-b'   -> False (not contiguous)

    if not slug_tail or not base_slug:

    s_parts = slug_tail.split("-")
    b_parts = base_slug.split("-")
    n, m = len(s_parts), len(b_parts)
    if n > m:

    for i in range(m - n + 1):

@dataclass
class T2SLMeta:
    version: Optional[int] = None
    count: Optional[int] = None
    blob_len: Optional[int] = None
    etag: Optional[str] = None
    last_modified: Optional[str] = None
    ts: Optional[float] = None

@dataclass
class LBDMeta:
    count: Optional[int] = None
    etag: Optional[str] = None
    last_modified: Optional[str] = None
    ts: Optional[float] = None

class T2SLBin:
    """
    TMDb → Letterboxd slug bin.
    Layout (LE):
      'T2SL' | u32 version | u32 count | u32 blob_len | u32 reserved
      u32 keys[count]  (sorted; key = (tmdb<<1)|(isTv?1:0))
      u32 vals[count]  (low 2 bits = type, payload = v>>2)
      u8  blob[blob_len]  (C-strings for OVERRIDE slugs)

    types: 0=EMPTY, 1=YEAR, 2=OVERRIDE, 3=YEAR_N (payload=(year<<7)|n)
    """
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.meta = T2SLMeta()
        self._keys: Optional[List[int]] = None
        self._vals: Optional[List[int]] = None
        self._blob: Optional[bytes] = None

    def load_from_bytes(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        dv = memoryview(data)
        if len(dv) < 20: raise ValueError("t2sl: too short")
        if bytes(dv[:4]).decode("ascii","ignore") != "T2SL": raise ValueError("t2sl: bad magic")
        version, count, blob_len, _reserved = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", dv, 4)
        off = 20
        keys = list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{count}I", dv, off)); off += count*4
        vals = list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{count}I", dv, off)); off += count*4
        blob = bytes(dv[off:off+blob_len])
        self.meta.version, self.meta.count, self.meta.blob_len = version, count, blob_len
        self._keys, self._vals, self._blob = keys, vals, blob

    def composite_key(self, tmdb_id: int, is_tv: bool) -> int:
        return ((tmdb_id & 0xFFFFFFFF) << 1) | (1 if is_tv else 0)

    def _bsearch(self, comp_key: int) -> int:
        keys = self._keys or []
        lo, hi = 0, len(keys)-1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo+hi) >> 1
            k = keys[mid]
            if k == comp_key: return mid
            if k < comp_key: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid - 1
        return -1

    def _read_cstring(self, offset: int) -> str:
        blob = self._blob or b""
        end = blob.find(b"\x00", offset)
        if end < 0: end = len(blob)
        return blob[offset:end].decode("utf-8","replace")

    def resolve_slug(self, tmdb_id: int, media: str, tmdb_title: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], str]:
        if not self._keys: return (None, "none")
        is_tv = media.lower() == "tv"
        idx = self._bsearch(self.composite_key(tmdb_id, is_tv))
        if idx >= 0:
            v = self._vals[idx]; typ = v & 0x3; payload = v >> 2
            base = title_to_compare_slug(tmdb_title or "")
            if typ == 0: return (base, "bin")
            if typ == 1: return (f"{base}-{payload}", "bin")
            if typ == 2: return (self._read_cstring(payload), "bin")
            if typ == 3:
                year = (payload >> 7); n = payload & 0x7F
                return (f"{base}-{year}-{n}", "bin")
        return (None, "none")

class LBDPairs:
    """Letterboxd filmId → TMDb: flattened u32 pairs [filmId, packed=(tmdb<<1|isTv)]."""
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.meta = LBDMeta()
        self._pairs: Optional[List[int]] = None

    def load_from_bytes(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        it = struct.iter_unpack("<I", data)
        arr = [x[0] for x in it]
        if len(arr) % 2: arr = arr[:-1]
        self._pairs = arr
        self.meta.count = len(arr)//2

    def lookup(self, film_id: int) -> Optional[Tuple[int,bool]]:
        a = self._pairs or []
        lo, hi = 0, (len(a)//2) - 1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo+hi) >> 1
            k = a[mid<<1]
            if k == film_id:
                packed = a[(mid<<1)+1]
                return (packed>>1, bool(packed & 1))
            if k < film_id: lo = mid + 1
            else: hi = mid - 1
        return None

# -------------- Cache & bin I/O --------------
class CacheManager:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.persist = PERSIST_TO_DISK_DEFAULT
        self.t2sl_bin = T2SLBin()
        self.lbd_pairs = LBDPairs()
        self.t2sl_loaded = False
        self.lbd_loaded = False

    def _ensure_dir(self):
        if not os.path.isdir(CACHE_DIR):
            os.makedirs(CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    def _load_meta(self, path: str) -> Dict:
        if not os.path.isfile(path): return {}
        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return {}

    def _save_meta(self, path: str, meta: Dict):
        self._ensure_dir()
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(meta, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _load_bytes(self, path: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as f: return f.read()
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _save_bytes(self, path: str, data: bytes):
        self._ensure_dir()
        with open(path, "wb") as f: f.write(data)

    def _fetch_bin(self, url: str, meta_in: Dict, conditional=True) -> Tuple[bool, bytes, Dict]:
        headers = {}
        if conditional:
            if meta_in.get("etag"): headers["If-None-Match"] = meta_in["etag"]
            if meta_in.get("last_mod") or meta_in.get("last_modified"):
                headers["If-Modified-Since"] = meta_in.get("last_mod") or meta_in.get("last_modified")
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if r.status_code == 304:
            return True, b"", {"status":304, "etag": meta_in.get("etag"), "last_mod": meta_in.get("last_mod")}
        r.raise_for_status()
        return True, r.content, {"status": r.status_code, "etag": r.headers.get("ETag"), "last_mod": r.headers.get("Last-Modified")}

    # -- public: ensure/clear bins --
    def ensure_t2sl(self, check_update=False, force_redownload=False) -> Tuple[bool,str]:
        disk_meta = self._load_meta(META_T2SL) if self.persist else {}
        disk_bytes = self._load_bytes(FILE_T2SL) if self.persist else None

        need_fetch = force_redownload or (self.persist and not disk_bytes) or (not self.t2sl_loaded and not self.persist)
        if need_fetch:
            ok, data, hdr = self._fetch_bin(BIN_URL_T2SL, disk_meta, conditional=not force_redownload)
            if not ok: return False, "Download failed"
            if hdr.get("status")==304 and disk_bytes: data = disk_bytes
            if not data: return False, "No data for T2SL"
            self.t2sl_bin.load_from_bytes(data); self.t2sl_loaded = True
            if self.persist:
                self._save_bytes(FILE_T2SL, data)
                meta = {
                    "ts": time.time(), "v": self.t2sl_bin.meta.version, "count": self.t2sl_bin.meta.count,
                    "blob_len": self.t2sl_bin.meta.blob_len, "etag": hdr.get("etag"), "last_mod": hdr.get("last_mod")
                }
                self._save_meta(META_T2SL, meta)
            return True, "Loaded"
        if check_update:
            ok, data, hdr = self._fetch_bin(BIN_URL_T2SL, disk_meta, conditional=True)
            if not ok: return False, "Update check failed"
            if hdr.get("status")==304:
                return True, "Up to date (304)"
            self.t2sl_bin.load_from_bytes(data); self.t2sl_loaded = True
            if self.persist:
                self._save_bytes(FILE_T2SL, data)
                meta = {
                    "ts": time.time(), "v": self.t2sl_bin.meta.version, "count": self.t2sl_bin.meta.count,
                    "blob_len": self.t2sl_bin.meta.blob_len, "etag": hdr.get("etag"), "last_mod": hdr.get("last_mod")
                }
                self._save_meta(META_T2SL, meta)
            return True, "Updated"
        if self.persist and disk_bytes and not self.t2sl_loaded:
            self.t2sl_bin.load_from_bytes(disk_bytes); self.t2sl_loaded = True
            return True, "Loaded from disk"
        return (self.t2sl_loaded, "Already loaded" if self.t2sl_loaded else "Not loaded")

    def ensure_lbd(self, check_update=False, force_redownload=False) -> Tuple[bool,str]:
        disk_meta = self._load_meta(META_LBD) if self.persist else {}
        disk_bytes = self._load_bytes(FILE_LBD) if self.persist else None

        need_fetch = force_redownload or (self.persist and not disk_bytes) or (not self.lbd_loaded and not self.persist)
        if need_fetch:
            ok, data, hdr = self._fetch_bin(BIN_URL_LBD, disk_meta, conditional=not force_redownload)
            if not ok: return False, "Download failed"
            if hdr.get("status")==304 and disk_bytes: data = disk_bytes
            if not data: return False, "No data for LBD pairs"
            self.lbd_pairs.load_from_bytes(data); self.lbd_loaded = True
            if self.persist:
                self._save_bytes(FILE_LBD, data)
                meta = {"ts": time.time(), "count": self.lbd_pairs.meta.count, "etag": hdr.get("etag"), "last_mod": hdr.get("last_mod")}
                self._save_meta(META_LBD, meta)
            return True, "Loaded"
        if check_update:
            ok, data, hdr = self._fetch_bin(BIN_URL_LBD, disk_meta, conditional=True)
            if not ok: return False, "Update check failed"
            if hdr.get("status")==304:
                return True, "Up to date (304)"
            self.lbd_pairs.load_from_bytes(data); self.lbd_loaded = True
            if self.persist:
                self._save_bytes(FILE_LBD, data)
                meta = {"ts": time.time(), "count": self.lbd_pairs.meta.count, "etag": hdr.get("etag"), "last_mod": self.last_mod if hasattr(self, 'last_mod') else hdr.get("last_mod")}
                self._save_meta(META_LBD, meta)
            return True, "Updated"
        if self.persist and disk_bytes and not self.lbd_loaded:
            self.lbd_pairs.load_from_bytes(disk_bytes); self.lbd_loaded = True
            return True, "Loaded from disk"
        return (self.lbd_loaded, "Already loaded" if self.lbd_loaded else "Not loaded")

    def clear_t2sl(self):
        self.t2sl_bin = T2SLBin(); self.t2sl_loaded = False
        if self.persist:
            for p in (FILE_T2SL, META_T2SL):
                try:
                    if os.path.exists(p): os.remove(p)
                except Exception: pass

    def clear_lbd(self):
        self.lbd_pairs = LBDPairs(); self.lbd_loaded = False
        if self.persist:
            for p in (FILE_LBD, META_LBD):
                try:
                    if os.path.exists(p): os.remove(p)
                except Exception: pass

# -------------- Letterboxd resolvers & scrapers --------------
def resolve_slug_via_redirect(tmdb_id: int) -> Optional[str]:
    url = f"{LBX_ORIGIN}/tmdb/{tmdb_id}/"
    try:
        r = http_head(url, allow_redirects=True)
    except Exception:
        return None
    m = re.match(r"^https?://letterboxd\.com/film/([^/]+)/?$", r.url)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def letterboxd_similar_url(slug: str) -> str:    return f"{LBX_ORIGIN}/film/{slug}/similar/"
def letterboxd_themes_url(slug: str) -> str:     return f"{LBX_ORIGIN}/film/{slug}/themes/"
def letterboxd_nano_url(slug: str) -> str:       return f"{LBX_ORIGIN}/film/{slug}/nanogenres/"

def to_ajax_url(listing_url: str, page: int) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlunparse
    pu = urlparse(listing_url)
    parts = [p for p in pu.path.split("/") if p]
    if "films" in parts:
        i = parts.index("films")
        if i+1 >= len(parts) or parts[i+1] != "ajax":
            parts.insert(i+1, "ajax")
    path = "/" + "/".join(parts) + f"/page/{page}/"
    q = "esiAllowFilters=true"
    return urlunparse((pu.scheme, pu.netloc, path, "", q, ""))

def soup_from_url(url: str) -> BeautifulSoup:
    html = http_get(url).text
    return BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

def extract_similar(doc: BeautifulSoup) -> List[Tuple[int,str]]:
    out: List[Tuple[int,str]] = []
    seen = set()
    for el in doc.select("[data-film-id]"):
        fid = el.get("data-film-id")
        if not fid or fid in seen: continue
        seen.add(fid)
        name = (
            el.get("data-item-name") or el.get("data-film-name") or el.get("data-item-full-display-name")
            or el.get("data-original-title") or el.get("title")
            or (el.find("img").get("alt") if el.find("img") and el.find("img").get("alt") else "")
            or ""
        ).strip()
        name = re.sub(r"\s*\(\d{4}\)\s*$","", name)
        try: out.append((int(fid), name))
        except: pass
    return out

def extract_groups(doc: BeautifulSoup) -> List[Dict]:
    groups: List[Dict] = []
    for sec in doc.select("section.section.genre-group"):
        title = ""
        href_abs = None
        a = sec.select_one("h2 a[href]")
        if a:
            title = a.get_text(strip=True)
            href_rel = a.get("href")
            if href_rel:
                href_abs = requests.compat.urljoin(LBX_ORIGIN, href_rel)
        else:
            lab = sec.select_one("h2 .label")
            if lab: title = lab.get_text(strip=True)
        seen = set()
        items = []
        for el in sec.select("[data-film-id]"):
            fid = el.get("data-film-id")
            if not fid or fid in seen: continue
            seen.add(fid)
            name = (
                el.get("data-item-name") or el.get("data-film-name") or el.get("data-item-full-display-name")
                or el.get("data-original-title") or el.get("title")
                or (el.find("img").get("alt") if el.find("img") and el.find("img").get("alt") else "")
                or ""
            ).strip()
            name = re.sub(r"\s*\(\d{4}\)\s*$","", name)
            items.append({"id": int(fid), "name": name})
        if title and items:
            groups.append({"title": title, "href": href_abs, "items": items})
    return groups

def extract_ajax_tiles(doc: BeautifulSoup) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[int,str]], bool, bool]:
    rows: List[Tuple[int,str]] = []
    seen = set()
    for el in doc.select("ul.poster-list li [data-film-id]"):
        fid = el.get("data-film-id")
        if not fid or fid in seen: continue
        seen.add(fid)
        name = (
            el.get("data-item-name") or el.get("data-film-name") or el.get("data-item-full-display-name")
            or el.get("data-original-title") or el.get("title")
            or (el.find("img").get("alt") if el.find("img") and el.find("img").get("alt") else "")
            or ""
        ).strip()
        name = re.sub(r"\s*\(\d{4}\)\s*$","", name)
        rows.append((int(fid), name))
    pag = doc.select_one(".pagination")
    has_next = bool(pag and pag.select_one("a.next"))
    has_prev = bool(pag and (pag.select_one("a.previous") or pag.select_one("a.prev")))
    return rows, has_next, has_prev

# -------------- Orchestration --------------
class LBXEngine:
    def __init__(self, cache: "CacheManager") -> None:
        self.cache = cache

    def resolve_slug(self, tmdb_id: int, media: str, tmdb_title: str) -> Tuple[str,str]:
        slug, via = self.cache.t2sl_bin.resolve_slug(tmdb_id, media, tmdb_title)
        if slug: return slug, via
        slug = resolve_slug_via_redirect(tmdb_id)
        return (slug, "letterboxd-resolver" if slug else "none")

    def map_rows(self, rows: List[Tuple[int,str]]):
        t0 = time.time()
        mapped = []
        matched = 0
        for fid, name in rows:
            m = self.cache.lbd_pairs.lookup(fid)
            if m:
                tmdb_id, is_tv = m
                mapped.append((fid, name, tmdb_id, 1 if is_tv else 0)); matched += 1
            else:
                mapped.append((fid, name, None, 0))
        return mapped, matched, len(rows)-matched, int((time.time()-t0)*1000)

    def get_similar(self, tmdb_id: int, media: str, tmdb_title: str):
        t0 = time.time()
        slug, via = self.resolve_slug(tmdb_id, media, tmdb_title)
        if not slug: raise RuntimeError("Could not resolve Letterboxd slug.")
        doc = soup_from_url(letterboxd_similar_url(slug))
        rows = extract_similar(doc)
        mapped, matched, unmatched, ms_map = self.map_rows(rows)
        return {
            "slug": slug, "via": via, "rows": mapped,
            "matched": matched, "unmatched": unmatched,
            "ms_map": ms_map, "ms_total": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)
        }

    def get_groups(self, kind: str, tmdb_id: int, media: str, tmdb_title: str):
        t0 = time.time()
        slug, via = self.resolve_slug(tmdb_id, media, tmdb_title)
        if not slug: raise RuntimeError("Could not resolve Letterboxd slug.")
        url = letterboxd_themes_url(slug) if kind=="themes" else letterboxd_nano_url(slug)
        doc = soup_from_url(url)
        groups0 = extract_groups(doc)
        matched_total = 0; unmatched_total = 0
        t_map0 = time.time()
        groups = []
        for g in groups0:
            mapped, matched, unmatched, _ = self.map_rows([(it["id"], it["name"]) for it in g["items"]])
            matched_total += matched; unmatched_total += unmatched
            groups.append({
                "title": g["title"],
                "href": g["href"],
                "items": [{"id": fid,"name": nm,"tmdb_id": tmdb,"is_tv": is_tv} for fid,nm,tmdb,is_tv in mapped]
            })
        return {
            "slug": slug, "via": via, "groups": groups,
            "matched": matched_total, "unmatched": unmatched_total,
            "ms_map": int((time.time()-t_map0)*1000),
            "ms_total": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)
        }

    def get_group_page(self, listing_url: str, page: int, ctx: Dict):
        t0 = time.time()
        ajax = to_ajax_url(listing_url, page)
        doc = soup_from_url(ajax)
        rows, has_next, has_prev = extract_ajax_tiles(doc)
        mapped, matched, unmatched, ms_map = self.map_rows(rows)
        return {
            "page": page,
            "rows": [{"id": fid,"name": nm,"tmdb_id": tmdb,"is_tv": is_tv} for fid,nm,tmdb,is_tv in mapped],
            "has_next": has_next, "has_prev": has_prev,
            "matched": matched, "unmatched": unmatched,
            "ms_map": ms_map, "ms_total": int((time.time()-t0)*1000),
            "slug": ctx.get("slug"), "via": ctx.get("via")
        }

class NetClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self._mode = "requests"
        self._rx = None
        try:
            import httpx
            # HTTP/2 client; follow redirects; small timeouts
            self._rx = httpx.Client(http2=True, headers=DEFAULT_HEADERS, timeout=15.0, follow_redirects=True)
            self._mode = "httpx"
        except Exception:
            import requests, urllib3
            from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
            from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
            self._sess = requests.Session()
            # pool + retries; reuses TLS connection for subsequent calls
            retry = Retry(total=0, connect=0, read=0, backoff_factor=0)
            adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=4, pool_maxsize=8, max_retries=retry)
            self._sess.mount("https://", adapter)
            self._sess.mount("http://", adapter)
            self._sess.headers.update(DEFAULT_HEADERS)

    def get(self, url: str):
        if self._mode == "httpx":
            r = self._rx.get(url)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.text
        else:
            r = self._sess.get(url, timeout=15, allow_redirects=True)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.text

    def head(self, url: str):
        if self._mode == "httpx":
            r = self._rx.head(url)
            # if servers dislike HEAD, fall back to GET (mirrors your code)
            if r.status_code >= 400 and r.status_code not in (301,302,303,307,308):

            r.raise_for_status()

            r.raise_for_status()
